reviews.review: the usage of ai in this game turned me off completely, especially for something as simple as npcs/therapy animal icons on the computer.
reviews.developer_response:
There is no usage of AI other than the capsule and a few in-game icons, which will be changed very soon by a real artist.

NPCs are provided by 3D Artist "Jordbugg" and animals are provided by the company "Red Deer".

It's honestly made me very sad to see this review that suggests that I do not pay real artists. I worked for 9 months straight on this, spent out of my own pocket from money from my previous job, hired part-time developers, artists, and I was VERY active in many Discord servers asking for help from real people. I simply do not have an infinite budget and I had to make-do with what I have.

It would have been much more fair if you joined my Discord channel and asked me about AI usage instead of just leaving a negative review straight out.

I hope you enjoy the game anyway.
